## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Validation passes: `python3 scripts/validate_exercises.py`
- [ ] XP values match the standard per exercise ID
- [ ] Scenarios use realistic, domain-specific details
- [ ] Tasks are clear and action-oriented
- [ ] Criteria are numbered (1) 2) 3)...) with 4-7 testable items
- [ ] Materials are provided where needed
- [ ] No real patient/client/personal data used
- [ ] Frontend builds: `cd frontend && npm run build`
